name: f1-live-track-visualizer
description: Unofficial Formula 1 race replay dashboard built on OpenF1 data.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: npm run build && npm --prefix backend run start
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
